descriptionZh: 資訊共享空間設有 6 部安裝了不同軟件的電腦，旨在支援讀者搜尋資訊。每部電腦均連接到館內的影印/打印機及掃描器。
descriptionEn: The Information Commons provides six computers with different software to support information search. Each workstation is connected to the library's printing, photocopying, and scanning facilities.
tipZh: 需要快速查資料時，可先在這裡搜尋，再到對應館藏區取書。
tipEn: Start your search here, then head to the matching collection area to find physical materials.
imageAlt: 資訊共享空間的電腦工作站 / Computer workstations in the Information Commons

locationZh: 演藝學院圖書館高層地下
descriptionZh: 圖書館共有三間不同大小的研討室，支援學術交流及圖書館讀者教育服務。各研討室設有電腦及各類影音器材。教職員及學生可透過圖書館網頁的研討室預約系統預約使用。
descriptionEn: The library has three seminar rooms of different sizes for academic exchange and user education activities. Rooms are equipped with computers and audio-visual devices, and can be booked online via the library website.
tipZh: 小組匯報前可先預約房間，避免高峰時段沒有空位。
tipEn: Reserve early before presentations, especially during peak periods.
imageAlt: 研討室內部 / Interior of a seminar room

locationZh: 演藝學院圖書館高層地下
descriptionZh: 學習共享空間旨在提供促進學術交流的空間。空間內共有 26 個座位及可移動、自由組合的工作枱，以滿足不同學習模式的需要。
descriptionEn: The Learning Commons is designed for collaborative and flexible study. It includes 26 seats and movable tables that can be rearranged for different learning activities.
tipZh: 如果你要討論功課，這裡比安靜區更適合。
tipEn: Choose this space for discussion-based work instead of silent study zones.
imageAlt: 學習共享空間座位與工作枱 / Seats and movable tables in the Learning Commons

locationZh: 演藝學院圖書館高層地下
descriptionZh: 學習資源室主要為讀者提供個人及小組學習空間；室內備有個人研習亭、視聽亭、小組書枱及 10 部個人電腦/iMac。所有電腦均連接到影印/打印機及 A3 掃描器。開放時間為每日早上 9 時至晚上 11:30。
descriptionEn: The Learning Resources Room supports both individual and small-group study. Facilities include study booths, audio-visual booths, group desks, and 10 PCs/iMacs connected to printers and an A3 scanner. It opens daily from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM.
tipZh: 若圖書館正門關閉，可留意指示從指定入口進入。
tipEn: After-hours access may use a designated entrance, so check posted directions.
imageAlt: 學習資源室設備 / Facilities in the Learning Resources Room

descriptionZh: 學院圖書館收藏了 45,700 件視聽資料、1,000 個 CD-ROM 及 DVD-ROM 電腦檔案，以及 142 種現期印刷版期刊。
descriptionEn: The Academy Library houses 45,700 audio-visual items, 1,000 computer files on CD-ROM and DVD-ROM, and 142 active printed journal titles.
tipZh: 做表演藝術研究時，這區的影音館藏很有幫助。
tipEn: This section is especially useful for performance and media research.
imageAlt: 影音資料區館藏 / Audio-visual collections

descriptionZh: 學院圖書館的實體館藏包含超過 28,500 冊中文書籍、近 54,200 冊英文或其他語言書籍，以及約 28,100 份樂譜和管弦樂分譜。
descriptionEn: The Main Stack includes over 28,500 Chinese volumes, nearly 54,200 English or other-language volumes, and around 28,100 music scores and orchestral parts.
tipZh: 先記下索書號再找書，會更快找到正確書架。
tipEn: Note the call number first to locate the right shelf faster.
imageAlt: 主要館藏書架 / Shelves in the Main Stack

descriptionZh: 館內設有兩間 Solo Pods，配備隔音、可調校燈光、無線充電及電源插座，供個人使用。教職員和學生可透過圖書館網頁的研討室及 Solo Pod 預約系統辦理預約。
descriptionEn: Two Solo Pods are available for individual use with soundproofing, adjustable lighting, wireless charging, and power outlets. Staff and students can reserve them via the library booking system.
tipZh: 想錄音或需要高度專注時，Solo Pod 是理想選擇。
tipEn: Use a Solo Pod when you need focused work or quiet recording.
